title: Teacher-written fact sheet: the 2010 Eyjafjallajokull eruption
subject: English
source: Written for english/y3 lesson 105 (Teacher-written fact sheet: the 2010 Eyjafjallajokull eruption (pupil PDF))
intro: Lesson 105: Researching and planning our report on the 2010 Iceland eruption. Read the ideas from the lesson, then do the tasks.

head: Question
Fact
rows: A volcano called Eyjafjallajökull erupted under a glacier in southern Iceland.
It began in March 2010; the big ash eruption started on 14 April 2010.
Melting ice cooled the lava quickly, so it shattered into fine ash.
The ash cloud drifted over Europe. Ash can damage jet engines, so much of Europe's airspace closed for about six days.
Millions of travellers were stuck; flights were cancelled across Europe.
People living nearby were moved to safety; no one died from the eruption.
